graph.memory_revision: exact memory ref plus mandatory source dependency groups
graph.fact: synthetic explicit fact identifier bound to a single memory revision; native fact withdrawal producer not implemented
graph.dependency_groups: DNF: each group contains mandatory dependencies; groups are alternative provenance. Any changed/invalid branch taints original artifact. A wholly live alternative allows only a new rebuild request, not reuse of old bytes. All nodes must be traceable to current roots.
graph.cycle: hold cycle and downstream; no circular self-support
graph.missing: hold object and downstream; missing provenance blocks product integration
graph.multi_source: all required sources must remain current; erasing one invalidates dependent composite
graph.invalidation_unavailable: affected unsupported/unknown invalidator becomes explicit hold and propagates; planner never pretends it removed bytes
graph.scope_isolation: exact four fields; same hash/text in other scope out_of_scope and never cascaded; foreign dependency holds

revision.default: content revision change invalidates old state and requests separate DYN ResetRevision pending template. No old values/receipts/evidence/cursor transfer, no activation grant. Same body newer revision still separate. Lower current revision held as regression.
revision.same_revision_different_hash: invalidate snapshot as conflict; never migrate numeric state
revision.correction_pending: existing active memory continues, held candidate does not win by proposal metadata
revision.correction_confirmed: current status/ref/revision governs, old superseded revision cannot serve as current
revision.withdraw_a_keep_b: fact_a and fact_b are separate synthetic nodes within same exact memory revision. Withdrawing a invalidates a dependents; b stays only if its independent origin remains current. Whole-revision/source erasure still invalidates both. Composite a+b invalidated; valid alternative requires rebuild, not implicit logical inverse or AGM claim.

history.eligibility: memoryAt metadata semantics: as_of observed timeline/current authorization/withheld checks/effective window; empty or missing timeline history_not_recorded, known creation before requested time yields not_created
history.body: old hash timeline is not old body archive; different current body hash content_unavailable
history.execution: historical_only never becomes fresh dynamic/current/publish/restore evidence; current source refs rechecked

restore.readback: every snapshot field digest must be known and equal readback digest. Store success alone is insufficient; missing/unknown/unequal blocks all keep candidates
restore.current_check: current authorization, ledger, exact scope/source/ref/revision/lifecycle checked at/after snapshot. Missing deletion ledger distinct from known empty. Changed ledger does not erase unrelated valid scopes; revalidation always required.
restore.publication: only candidate plan; actual_publication_authorized always false. CheckRestorePublication/write gate/current erasure must be fenced by actual owner immediately before publication
restore.new_process: byte serialization then independent new Python process yields same pure plan; no assertion of actual persistence recovery
restore.rollback: no body reconstruction, cursor advancement, inverse jump, reactivation or old revision resurrection; numeric_state_updates=0
restore.requested_not_performed: This planner neither resets DYN state nor rebuilds alternative artifacts. DYN ResetRevision request never creates a persisted pending snapshot, receipt, accepted time or cursor; integration owner must validate separately.

evidence: per exact scoped collection/id, each facet separately supplied. observed statuses need jobs fullref metadata; no receipt authenticity proven by this model. Unknown is not zero/false/completed. Legal hold/runtime partial/backup wait are kept separate. Synthetic closure is NOT actual physical erasure proof even when supplied receipts all claim complete.
output: objects with action/reason; planned invalidations, held/rebuild lists, separate revision requests, restore field comparison/candidate set, per-target evidence vector; no source writes or numeric reducer

schema.top: All original fields plus metadata_profile and root_metadata. Original current.records per-record fields retained; accepted collection set extends to seven only under v2. New metadata_root nodes require exact ref, fact_id=null, ordinary required-AND dependencies; v2 permits only metadata_root+original derived kinds, no historical query or fact withdrawal until separate profile.
schema.expected_root: closed {scope,ref}; full scoped fixture ref tuples of all roots covered by external metadata inventory, exactly matching graph roots and root_metadata descriptors; no omitted roots.
schema.root_metadata: closed {scope,ref,sources,target,relations,evaluation}; sources/ref arrays and optional target all exact pinned refs. evaluation is null for non-evaluation records; otherwise closed {eval_type,spec_ref,trial_ref,calibration_ref}. No raw native DTO, body, Removal.Note or By.
schema.current_records: Current observation fields kept exact original shape. approved remains boolean but used only for memories. Ordinary eval currentness is exact scope/ref/revision/hash + nonerased/nonquarantined/active, no approval or task success assertion. Nullable history remains no native timeline extraction claim.
schema.v2_external_string_domain: Workspace/project: Go scopeName nonempty UTF8bytes<256, no dot/dotdot, slash/backslash or Cc. User/agent: UTF8bytes<256 only, empty/Cc/Cf/path-like values allowed as actual native validScope. Ref ID: Go validRunLabel1..256 UTF8bytes, Go TrimSpace unchanged and no Cc; Cf not prohibited. Invalid Unicode cannot round-trip UTF8 and rejects. No normalization/alias. Node IDs stay fixture labels; legacy strict domain unchanged.

mapping.required_edges: All Sources, optional Target, Relations, Evaluation spec/trial/calibration refs form one AND group, never alternative. Trial has at least one task and one run relation; all present required refs consumed, no first-match selection.
mapping.source_projection: Native Sources carry SourceID; future authorized metadata producer must resolve current exact scoped revision/hash. No alias to native Ref or fake hash. Producers absent; model input is explicitly synthetic metadata observations.
mapping.source_and_memory: New-profile metadata roots allow source-free ordinary records as observed roots; declared edges still mandatory. No fake source prerequisite. Legacy source/memory profile remains identical.
mapping.unknown: Absent current records hold. Unknown coverage holds all current-scope nodes. Unsupported refs/schema, missing topology/extraction edge or coverage root reject. Stale/hash-conflict ordinary and memory metadata roots hold. Explicit deletion/erasure invalidates. Nonactive known record skips; no history or physical-erasure inference.
mapping.cycles: Reuse original dependency topological cycle hold; no separate state/reducer.

coverage.value: SHA256(profile domain + raw({id,source_commit,collections,expected_roots,extraction_sha256})); raw sorts keys, compact UTF8+newline; supplied list order preserved.
coverage.binding: Graph root+descriptor full scoped tuple sets must equal independently supplied expected_roots; required edges exactly match each descriptor. Thus six hashes equal cannot mask missing declared roots or edges.
coverage.restore: Six required restore field names/meanings unchanged. Separate profile snapshot/readback coverage digests must both equal computed coverage binding for restoration; unknown/different holds with metadata_profile_readback reason. Digests/confirmed observations do not authenticate source or actual DB readback.
coverage.extraction: Explicit extraction_sha256=SHA256(sys04-main-eval-roots-v1:extraction\0+raw(root_metadata)); coverage binding includes this field. Projection is still externally supplied metadata, not authenticated source/body extraction.

metadata_profiles.hash: Legacy digest domain unchanged; v2 uses sys-lifecycle-metadata-v2\0; input raw sorted compact representation from original raw helper. No fixed DYN/v1/SYS01 contract mutation.
